files.description: Company revenue per calendar quarter (30 rows, oldest first, one row per quarter with no gaps): quarter_start (first day of the quarter as text, YYYY-MM-DD, from 2019-01-01 to 2026-04-01), revenue (whole number), new_accounts (whole number).

task_text: For every quarter in the revenue file, report the moment at which the quarter closes (its last instant) together with the revenue. `result` should be a table with the columns quarter_end and revenue, oldest quarter first.
intended_computation: For each of the 30 quarters, compute the last instant of the quarter that starts at quarter_start (e.g. 2019-03-31 23:59:59.999...) and return it with revenue, ascending by quarter_end.

acceptable_variants.notes: the last instant may be given to the second, millisecond, microsecond or nanosecond.

predicted_direction.reason: the quarter end moves from the last nanosecond to the last microsecond; both mark the close of the quarter

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
